summary.text: Paul Frost is a Republican state representative who has represented the Massachusetts House of Representatives 7th Worcester District since 1997 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He holds a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Amherst and has served on the Auburn Republican Town Committee.

paragraphs.text: Paul Frost earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Massachusetts Amherst, according to Ballotpedia, and has served on the Auburn Republican Town Committee.
He assumed office in the 7th Worcester District in 1997.
For 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the House Rules Committee, the Health Care Financing and Rules joint committees, and as ranking minority member of the Election Laws Joint Committee.
